WildSpark 2.2.63 — Stable release

- Integrate Forever Minimap Target into WildMaps. Enable Target and Focus tracking from the WildMaps settings tab or Blizzard’s minimap tracking menu; choices persist per character. Target tracking defaults on.
- Keep the movable WildMaps minimap lens and remove the separate dungeon atlas and its tiles from the active addon. The full atlas source remains archived in the repository.
- Update the embedded WildFire camping kit and WildInfo quest-drop/respawn data.
- Allow WildBuffs to select friendly players in battlegrounds and arenas when PvP flag state is delayed, while retaining open-world PvE flag protection.
- Preserve the author attribution and GPL-3.0-or-later license for Forever Minimap Target in the addon package.

The GitHub package workflow validates the release ZIP. Live-game behavior, including minimap target tracking and PvP targeting, has not been tested in the client.
